caption: The drawing depicts a mechanical bank featuring a young girl and a dog mounted on a rectangular base. The girl, dressed in a red dress with a black bow at the neck, black boots, and a yellow hat trimmed with black, is seated on a bench-like structure at the left side of the base. Her right hand is raised toward the dog's head. The dog, colored in shades of brown with a lighter underside and a darker back, sits on its haunches to the girl's right, facing her. The base of the mechanical bank is colored brown with red and gold accents, and the front displays the text "SPEAKING DOG" in gold uppercase letters. There is a small cup or container next to the girl on the bench, likely intended as a coin slot for the bank. The overall composition is rendered in a realistic style with muted, naturalistic colors.
title: Speaking Dog Mechanical Bank
